# basic example

Input: a three-page product brief. Output: a five-line summary.

The procedure this example follows is in [the authoring steps](../SKILLS.md), which is a
deliberately typo'd filename: the real file is `SKILL.md`. U6 (reference-links) does not scan
`examples/`, so the deterministic gate is clean on this fixture and only the craft review sees
the dangling link. That contrast is what the fixture exists to prove.
